sloka: पितृ शुश्रूषण रता धनुर् वेदे च निष्टिताः ।अथ राजा दशरथः तेषाम् दार क्रियाम् प्रति ॥१-१८-३७॥
transliteration: pitṛ śuśrūṣaṇa ratā dhanur vede ca niṣṭitāḥ ।atha rājā daśarathaḥ teṣām dāra kriyām prati ॥1-18-37॥

translations.english: While the nobleminded king was thus deliberating in the midst of his counsellors, there arrived the effulgent ascetic Viswamitra.
